input.rationale: There is no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement (a search for "insur" returns nothing). HDI hosts the Site on its own server and receives and processes customer order data, so no insurance for a data-processing vendor is walk-away territory. We inserted a short insurance paragraph (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request) as new Section 10.9.

input.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: Fees are purely a revenue share on actual Net Sales, with the first $11,000 per month excluded; there is no minimum spend, guaranteed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic anywhere (no hits for "minimum"), and no volume cap on our usage. This matches our preferred position. The separate Termination Payment is addressed under LD.

Article 4 deals only with term, notice and the Termination Payment; nothing requires HDI to hand back our Content, user information or customer/order data, to assist with migrating the Site, or to delete data afterwards, and the Section 1.4 access rights do not survive (10.7 preserves only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10). We inserted a transition-assistance and data-return provision as new Section 4.3 (six months' assistance at HDI's rates, return within 30 days, certified deletion).
